title: projects/<name>/project.json: a project or a commission
description: projects/<name>/project.json: a project or a commission. Its images next to it (projects: in img/, with title.webp and info.webp; commissions: 1.webp … N.webp). VS Code reads this file (through the "$schema" line at the top of the JSON) to autocomplete, explain each field and underline what's wrong; the build and the preview use it to check.

images.description: How many images (1.webp … N.webp), no quotes: 27. Or the list of their names, in order: ["a.webp", "b.webp"]

extras.description: Optional: how many extra images, in extra/ (1.webp … N.webp).

password.description: Optional: a password to see the project.
